bootstrap: Percentile, source-group-stratified merged problem clusters; best deterministic baseline reselected within each replicate.

cost_accounting.cost_component_interpretation: Measured tokens include only known attempts; lower bounds and conservative charges are distinct. Component comparisons never impute missing native usage as measured zero.
cost_accounting.note: Saved cost accounting copied from the accepted report, deidentified by allowlist (no operational paths or job ownership). 14 reporting views over 13 physical configurations: the two Haiku views are reporting scopes of one physical lane and must not be summed; current selected cost views overlap and are never added to the grand cumulative. Charged tokens are budget charges, not measured tokens; unknown-usage attempts are counted, never imputed.

recovery_cost_accounting_scope.scope: Carried history (original campaign once plus correction-run attempts once, including the 106 environment-notice attempts at their conservative 40,000 charge) plus recovery attempts once. Recovery measurements, unknown attempts and lower bounds are separate components.

cost_accounting.scope: Historical campaign inventory once plus fresh physical dispatch inventory once. Current selected costs are overlapping views, never added to grand cumulative. Diagnostics are absent from all current metric/cost denominators.

note: Copied from the accepted report; intervals are the saved cluster bootstrap intervals; no new bootstrap. secondary_scorable is the complete 255-item scored evaluation set (it includes the 191 primary). Per-population inference_usage/output_usage/input_cache_usage_derivative and the two tokens-per-hit fields are the saved values with their known/unknown and measured-versus-charged distinctions.
